brief:
Israeli occupation forces restricted Palestinian movement in Hebron's Old City to facilitate and secure a weekly Israeli settler march, Eye on Palestine reported. The restrictions limit access through the historic district during the demonstration.

The weekly settler march in Hebron's Old City has long been a flashpoint, with Palestinian residents facing repeated movement curbs on market days and during settler processions through the Palestinian-majority neighborhood.

title: Israeli forces restrict Palestinian movement for settler march in Hebron
